![How to Export and Share ChatGPT Conversations (PDF included)](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/11181719-2042-0139-0000-0766ad4c9c65:4)
You can export your ChatGPT conversations `using OpenAI's built-in data export tool, browser extensions, or manual methods`.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1QEBxCJF1zu-1kbKzACbz2D6TOtQR-SB9oXH7484OnmPGikD_cV2kK3w7GK-Q82x8vogHJI5qO3fwT8m_sFh7gwj6E_swORayxK7FNqbdqpusxp33bu2iWK1RBkn5NtnlTg5Z92PNvx6JCDIF04NltshzkcR1ZSVtVobLAxih3dNZixG2gGF4Jph-vCPPTD76bBtm5scn4ReWJac48UpfBFgu6IHeIdeHIKMydhg69LY8AwTKAySOiZKOtcq3CMQIv5onoWOsW43Hp0DieYgYti0Ez45dt4)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jeS1JSln5T8&t=1)

### Method 1: Export All Chat History (Official Way)

OpenAI lets you download your entire chat history as a ZIP file containing JSON and HTML files.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1wzk1smksqmJFDZdbBnmvp5CcFgLn8tF_mQDfPNJ41tJZ4GpQGP_tQ97dyrFMrFB4tXniydX2yYGnkEfpQlVI-IlICPGAYQXJ7Ffr7wtvDZtQY7bDbKBP2Bz7WQwaED_-SExlQmt_qLvqv_z1S0ldlWk0ReU9NEg8MMN_ue83VBoL5k6AqHeRk0bqeE)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nque60rkbe8)

1. Log in to [ChatGPT](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUAHEIkXX12tzvf6w6ZScdcwtzdRakU9WGwL3jlXUqy-RVqFYDqL4UeXS-Zx346f_Wcg4HNWutpF_T8wXbU-NHgZXHBvjYtSHnfLk41Y05Adc).
2. Click your **profile icon** in the bottom-left corner.
3. Select **Settings** > **Data controls**.
4. Click **Export** or **Export data** , then confirm the request.
5. Complete any verification prompts (such as a code sent via email or SMS).
6. Wait for an email from OpenAI (this can take anywhere from a few minutes up to 7 days).
7. Click **Download data export** in the email. *Note: The link expires after 24 hours.* 
8. Unzip the downloaded file to view your data, which includes a readable `chat.html` file or raw JSON files.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/3QbxZr7J4L4)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E08P_Of2Ui8&t=4)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jeS1JSln5T8&t=1)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1wzk1smksqmJFDZdbBnmvp5CcFgLn8tF_mQDfPNJ41tJZ4GpQGP_tQ97dyrFMrFB4tXniydX2yYGnkEfpQlVI-IlICPGAYQXJ7Ffr7wtvDZtQY7bDbKBP2Bz7WQwaED_-SExlQmt_qLvqv_z1S0ldlWk0ReU9NEg8MMN_ue83VBoL5k6AqHeRk0bqeE)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nque60rkbe8)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXcfVI0bekwKJy6d5V0rfSIgSW_ABTihkTl_H88iPeUnh-pizUGJAMg3aGSuAssjdfRMhzuVH6fXFACaP2b5B1NzzF7N0E87qKPpV-cGQ19EWxzLQE3VhJqIYSKckX1C4gDYUFjO0CtYBnD-Az)[[7]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/esX4PAb2rbc)

### Method 2: Export a Single Conversation
If you only need to save or share one specific chat thread:

- **Share a read-only link:** Open the conversation, click the **Share** icon at the top right, and choose **Copy link**.
- **Save as PDF via browser:** Open the conversation, press `Ctrl + P` (Windows) or `Command + P` (Mac), and select **Save as PDF** as your destination.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF1_pI0VvRGp4Q7Qd7E6Xb9QgkhPkgsn5et1opXBSaFWJO0L2rcKCdT7ynKiD2ayaKoFTpTAEuAi31FmlPO2e9CTwZx7hP7PlqnR9LGN7j7OQ2q5KDHX99aFfFMOh4p6y0_4Z0pysWdB_1b470-r_evsUS5j4zOWEuxtkzXIVnNkzVPBpK3MUQunCL75F3sGp0Enf1XquT)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jeS1JSln5T8&t=1)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E08P_Of2Ui8&t=4)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3rCVXWIthDc&vl=en-US&t=9)

### Method 3: Use Browser Extensions or Scripts
Opinions are mixed on manual methods for large threads, as users on the [OpenAI Community Forum](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1QEBxCJF1zu-1kbKzACbz2D6TOtQR-SB9oXH7484OnmPGikD_cV2kK3w7GK-Q82x8vogHJI5qO3fwT8m_sFh7gwj6E_swORayxK7FNqbdqpusxp33bu2iWK1RBkn5NtnlTg5Z92PNvx6JCDIF04NltshzkcR1ZSVtVobLAxih3dNZixG2gGF4Jph-vCPPTD76bBtm5scn4ReWJac48UpfBFgu6IHeIdeHIKMydhg69LY8AwTKAySOiZKOtcq3CMQIv5onoWOsW43Hp0DieYgYti0Ez45dt4) note that lengthy threads can become cumbersome to manage. Many users prefer third-party options for more readable formats like Markdown, Word, Notion, or PDF:[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1QEBxCJF1zu-1kbKzACbz2D6TOtQR-SB9oXH7484OnmPGikD_cV2kK3w7GK-Q82x8vogHJI5qO3fwT8m_sFh7gwj6E_swORayxK7FNqbdqpusxp33bu2iWK1RBkn5NtnlTg5Z92PNvx6JCDIF04NltshzkcR1ZSVtVobLAxih3dNZixG2gGF4Jph-vCPPTD76bBtm5scn4ReWJac48UpfBFgu6IHeIdeHIKMydhg69LY8AwTKAySOiZKOtcq3CMQIv5onoWOsW43Hp0DieYgYti0Ez45dt4)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3rCVXWIthDc&vl=en-US&t=9)

- **Chrome Extensions:** Tools like [ExportGPT: Export ChatGPT Conversation](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn) let you one-click export active chats into PDF, Markdown, HTML, or Excel.[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn)
- **Open Source Scripts:** Developers can use command-line tools or console scripts like the [ChatGPT Conversation Exporter](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXWwyds17gXIpvBS7rwuK1hw6qbakpkiMk31jFE0c_iq_8GfTG6EJfeNstbYrKSDYJjTF_ngAgafuJlNYOAkt1bUyLBnHXhVQqMRvRbI664sci_iMUqzZ6-b7Ah6Il5jmoPGMhoA_NRE3mHyv2xocFg6XCQAyDQ0k) to pull full histories directly into local Markdown and JSON files.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXWwyds17gXIpvBS7rwuK1hw6qbakpkiMk31jFE0c_iq_8GfTG6EJfeNstbYrKSDYJjTF_ngAgafuJlNYOAkt1bUyLBnHXhVQqMRvRbI664sci_iMUqzZ6-b7Ah6Il5jmoPGMhoA_NRE3mHyv2xocFg6XCQAyDQ0k)
